I bought this fan based on dimensions and photo, as the old one didn't have any model number showing.  It was an exact fit, pretty easy to install.  As long as yours looks like this one and the opening is 7" by 7-1/4 to 7-1/2", you should be fine.  Don't bother to press on the bar, as it says stamped in the metal, to remove the old one.  Pry gently from the edge and it will drop down; then the new one will snap in.  While the old one is out, be sure to check the flapper in the vent.  Perhaps a blast of WD40 on the hinges is a good idea, and make sure nothing is impeding the swing.  Could be quieter, but I don't know if it is possible to make a fan like this quiet.  The price fluctuates, so you may want to wait if the price is near "list."
